name: nature-figure
description: Submission-grade Nature/high-impact journal figure workflow for Python or R. Publication-quality scientific figures with editable SVG/PDF/TIFF output. Supports matplotlib/seaborn and ggplot2/patchwork/ComplexHeatmap. Figure contract before plotting: claim → evidence chain → archetype → backend → journal contract.
when_to_use: User needs publication-ready figures for journals. Not for EDA or quick exploration plots.
